data.text: I’m in. I’ll catch 15 tons this month and pay the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, on the agreed terms: John, Jack, and Emma do the same, and Luke catches zero. Our neighbors need treatment, and this one-month exception comes with a recovery plan I’ll honor: at most 6 tons next month, then 10 tons once the lake is back at capacity. I’ll share my catch record and payment receipt. Luke, please confirm your zero catch and agreement to the recovery limits so we can finalize this before fishing.
